title: More pressure on a piston
hook: Change pressure and predict work by the gas.
misconception: work by the gas stays fixed when pressure doubles.
objective: Apply W = PΔV to compare work by the gas when pressure changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a constant-pressure expansion with the same volume change, W = PΔV. When pressure doubles, work by the gas becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model W = PΔV; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a constant-pressure expansion with the same volume change, with a nonzero initial result. If pressure triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on work by the gas?
recall.why: Apply W = PΔV under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
